schema_json.name: Mount Bromo

terrain: Volcanic sand sea, gentle slopes, stone stairs to crater rim
weather_by_season: Dry season (Apr-Sep): Clear skies, excellent sunrise visibility. Wet season (Oct-Mar): Frequent fog, rain, and limited visibility. Cold temperatures year-round at high altitude.
rainfall_intensity: Moderate during wet season (100-200mm/month), Low during dry season (20-50mm/month)
trail_details:
Jeep transfer to viewpoint (30 mins),
1km walk across sand sea (20-30 mins),
250 steps to crater rim (15-20 mins). Mostly flat with final ascent via stairs.
summary: Mount Bromo is located within the Tengger Caldera, East Java — straddling Probolinggo, Malang, Pasuruan, and Lumajang regencies, approximately 2–3 hours from Surabaya's Juanda Airport. At 2,329 m above sea level, it is an active volcano famous for its sunrise views across the Sea of Sand (Lautan Pasir). A 4WD jeep crosses the caldera floor to the viewpoint; crater rim access is on foot.
description:
Mount Bromo, standing at 2,
329 meters, is one of the most iconic volcanoes in Indonesia and the most famous in East Java. It is located within the massive Tengger Caldera, surrounded by the Sea of Sand (Lautan Pasir). The name 'Bromo' is derived from the Javanese pronunciation of Brahma, the Hindu creator god.

The volcano is part of the Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park and is sacred to the Tenggerese people, who are the descendants of the Majapahit empire. Every year, the Tenggerese hold the Yadnya Kasada ceremony where offerings are thrown into the crater to honor the mountain gods.

The sunrise view from viewpoints like Penanjakan or Kingkong Hill is considered one of the most spectacular in Southeast Asia, with Mount Semeru occasionally erupting in the background. The experience represents the perfect harmony between natural wonder and living culture.
highlight: Sunrise over Tengger Caldera and sacred Hindu ceremonies

physical_requirements: Moderate physical condition required. The main challenge is the 250-step staircase to the crater rim. Suitable for most fitness levels with proper pacing.
cultural_context: Mount Bromo is sacred to the Tenggerese Hindus, who believe it was created when a Hindu god cut off the top of Mount Semeru to place it where Bromo now stands. The Tenggerese are the only Hindu community in predominantly Muslim East Java, maintaining ancient Javanese Hindu traditions unchanged for centuries. Their connection to the volcano is central to their identity and spiritual practices. Bromo represents the element of Earth in Javanese cosmology - symbolizing fertility, endurance, and the bridge between divine and human.
tips_for_visitors: Jeep pickup 02:30–03:30 from hotel for Penanjakan viewpoint (arrive by 04:30 for sunrise). Sunrise 04:30–06:00. Tour typically finishes by 09:00–09:30. Depart around 3: 00 AM for sunrise viewing, wear multiple warm layers as temperatures drop to 5°C, bring camera for spectacular photos, consider horse ride across sand sea for authentic experience, respect temple and ceremonial areas, check weather forecast before visit
